description: A cramped walk wedged between two facades in slow structural surrender, close enough to touch both walls at once. What isn't rented out is stacked with other people's abandoned lives — chair legs, dead lamps, a wardrobe with no doors — chained together against the inevitable. Velk's Pre-Owned holds the middle of the walk, its window a chaos of salvaged furniture arranged with a curator's inexplicable pride. Everything smells of damp upholstery and someone else's cigarettes.

flags.intro_lore: Everything discarded in Coldwater ends up somewhere, and a lot of it ends up here, chained to a wall like it might still be worth stealing. Castoff Walk is narrow enough to be private and public at once — you can hear your neighbors argue through both walls, and Velk will happily sell you the chair to sit through it.

name: Castoff Walk
